description: A 2010–2024 continuous GNSS dataset for Taiwan is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Hsin Tung et al. Continuous Global Navigation Satellite System observations provide important constraints on crustal deformation and a wide range of geophysical and environmental processes. Here we present a 15-year continuous GNSS dataset for Taiwan, comprising observations from more than 300 continuously operating stations distributed across the island and covering the period from 2010 to 2024. Coverage: global (TW); published in 2026. The formats are not stated in the sources read. The data are held in Zenodo and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence is CC-BY-4.0, taken from DataCite rights of the deposit. Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support communication-network and digital-infrastructure studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
